captions.detailed: A swing axle rear suspension mechanism consisting of a central longitudinal support beam, a central differential housing, two pivoting half-axle tubes, and two outer wheel hubs. The central beam and differential housing are finished in a matte black color, while the outer wheel hubs and brake drums are styled in a contrasting light grey. The half-axle tubes pivot on horizontal revolute joints at their inner connections to the differential, allowing vertical swing, while the wheel hubs are mounted on continuous rotational joints at the outer ends.
captions.instruction: Generate a swing axle rear suspension assembly with a central black mounting beam, a central differential housing, and two half-axle tubes that pivot vertically. Add light grey wheel hubs on the outer ends of the tubes that can spin continuously on revolute joints.
captions.factory: Construct a main beam using a Box primitive and a differential housing using a combination of Box and Cylinder primitives. Create the left and right half-axle tubes by combining nested Cylinder primitives for the main shafts and joint collars. Model the wheel hubs using stepped Cylinders. Define revolute joints (articulations) for the swinging axles with horizontal rotation axes, and continuous joints for the wheel hubs with longitudinal rotation axes.
